domain_context: Mobile control app (PWA wrapper format) for an Idle Game Automation Stack. Power user, developer tool.

hierarchy.stats_value: font-mono text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-white

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Density and precision. The Control Room Grid protocol. High data visibility.
spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-[480px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 border-x border-white/10 shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col overflow-x-hidden
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (Strict 2px-4px max to maintain technical/terminal feel. Do not use large rounded corners)
spacing_and_layout.nav_bar: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-[480px] h-16 border-t border-white/10 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-around pb-safe z-50

buttons.primary: bg-green-500 text-black font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-wider font-bold rounded-sm px-4 py-2 hover:bg-green-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white font-mono text-sm rounded-sm px-4 py-2 border border-white/10 hover:bg-zinc-700

inputs.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-green-500/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500/50 font-mono

badges.style: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest border

json_viewer.style: bg-[#050505] border border-white/10 rounded-sm p-3 font-mono text-xs overflow-auto text-green-400

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle border illuminations. No heavy transforms. Keep it feeling like a hardware interface.
motion_and_interactions.loading: ASCII-style loaders or blinking cursor ('_') animations to emphasize the terminal feel.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, crisp transitions (150ms). No slow fades.

images.description: Abstract tech circuit background. Use behind the main dashboard summary block with high transparency (opacity-20).
Server cartridge icon. Use as a fallback thumbnail for Idle Games in the games list.
Sleeping robot illustration. Use for 'No Active Sessions' or 'No Games Added' empty states.

media.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react with standard straight/sharp lines.

instructions_to_main_agent: FRAMEWORK: The user asked for an 'Expo (React Native) mobile control app'. To simulate this in the web environment, wrap the entire application in a centered, mobile-sized container (max-w-[480px] min-h-screen) with a fixed bottom navigation bar.
AESTHETIC: This is a developer tool. It must look like a high-end CLI/Terminal UI. Heavy use of monospace fonts (JetBrains Mono) for numbers, labels, and titles.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn primitives but OVERRIDE their border-radii to 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none'. Strip away standard shadow styles and use 1px solid borders (border-white/10).
DASHBOARD: Feature a prominent 'Earnings' module using large monospace typography and the neon green accent. Show a dense, scrolling list of recent sessions.
DATA FORMATTING: Format configs as actual JSON blocks inside `<pre><code>` tags with the 'json_viewer' styles.
TESTING: Every clickable element, form input, and key data display MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.
